reply_text:

I recorded both approval requests. However, my direct messages to Ruth and June failed with channel_not_found, and I have no DM channel with either of them. Nobody has been notified yet. My earlier thread post said I had asked them, which was wrong. I posted a correction in the thread.

Please ping Ruth and June directly so they can approve. Once they do, I can draft or send the email.

I also checked the 10% figure. The only source I found is a 2025-11-17 #coastal-team correction from Bettina ("it's 10%", after a brief 12% note). I did not find the signed order form, so June should confirm the figure before it goes to Corinne.
